about: Written by tests/profile_resources.py, read by tests/worker_plan.py. tests: nodeid -> [seconds, MB of resident memory held only while the test ran]. typical_test_mb: 90th percentile of that. worker_mb: resident memory of a worker running a typical test. accumulated_mb: what all the workers of a parallel run of the whole suite gather on top, together.
measured: 2026-10-28 on Windows AMD64, 16/22 cores, Python 3.13.2, 4 files side by side
